queue.name: West-East Pipeline (ADNOC Hormuz-bypass, Jebel Dhanna/Habshan-Fujairah)
queue.note: New second crude line paralleling P0553/ADCOP (Habshan-Fujairah, operating since 2012, 406km/48in/1.8Mbd): under active construction since ~2023 (EPC/contractor awards), ~50% complete May 2026, targeting 2027 startup, ~$3bn, 48in diameter, ~1.5Mbd added capacity (combined Fujairah bypass ~3.3Mbd). Route reporting varies (Habshan-origin per some outlets, Jebel Dhanna-origin per others/contractor pages) and length varies (~300km vs ~500-520km) -- needs route reconciliation during vetting. All 5 non-empty strategies converged on this single project; regulators' Jan-2024 MEED brief (CPECC contract award) is treated as an earlier report on the same project per that strategy's own note.

evidence.note: MEC Engineering Group (contractor to Marks Projects Management/ADNOC Onshore) portfolio page: EPCM/detailed engineering design services for 'West to East Pipeline (WEP) Project', Jebel Dhanna Industrial Area; project ongoing since 2023 (site offices, laydown area, warehouses).

METALFAB E&C project-award notice: automated pig launchers/receivers supplied for the ADNOC/ENPPI 'West to East Pipeline (WEP) Project' - confirms ADNOC Onshore as end client and ENPPI as EPC contractor for this named line.

MEED project-intelligence brief: ADNOC close to awarding a contract for a pipeline to transport crude oil from Jebel Dhanna in Abu Dhabi to its oil terminal in Fujairah; contractor/length/diameter/capacity behind paywall.
GlobalData profile: Jebel Dhanna, Abu Dhabi -> Al Fujayrah, onshore oil pipeline, 520 km, operator ADNOC, listed as an upcoming/under-development project.
Route Jebel Dhanna (Ruwais)->Fujairah via Habshan; 1.5 mn b/d capacity; distinct second line alongside existing ADCOP (1.8 mn b/d); completion targeted 2027.
'New Fujairah Pipeline': Jebel Dhanna Port Oil Storage Depot -> Fujairah main oil terminal, 500 km, 1.5 mn b/d, ADNOC sponsor, second crude export line complementing ADCOP.

Project profile 'ADNOC Onshore - West to East Pipeline (WEP)': 520 km Jebel Dhanna terminal -> Fujairah Port, crossing five emirates, includes storage tanks and pumping stations; sponsor ADNOC Onshore.

Sheikh Khaled announces acceleration of new ADNOC pipeline project to double Fujairah bypass export capacity, targeting 2027; distinct from existing ADCOP (Habshan-Fujairah, 380km, ~1.5Mbd, operating since 2012).

Names it 'West-East Pipeline', ~300km, ~$3bn cost, would raise Fujairah bypass capacity from 1.8 to 3+ Mbd; ~50% complete per reports, targeting early/mid-2027 start; would carry Upper Zakum, Das Blend, Umm Lulu crude streams.

Confirms 'West-East Pipeline project', 48-inch diameter, 1.5mn b/d capacity, connects interior Abu Dhabi fields to Fujairah, under construction, operational 2027; combined with existing Habshan-Fujairah line would reach ~3.3mn b/d total.

ADNOC CEO Sultan Al Jaber quoted: project 'already almost 50% complete,' accelerating delivery toward 2027; refers to it as 'West-East Pipeline' / 'Hormuz Bypass Pipeline', complementary to (not replacing) existing Habshan-Fujairah line.
Refers to project as 'West-East 1 Pipeline'; will double ADNOC's Fujairah export capacity; operational target 2027; under development following UAE's May 2026 OPEC departure.
SPE/JPT trade coverage: new pipeline running parallel to the existing ~250-mile (Habshan-)Fujairah line, combined capacity ~3.6 million b/d once complete; ~50% complete, targeting 2027 start.

Confirms 'West-East pipeline expansion' name and 2027 operational target doubling Fujairah export capacity; this piece's length/diameter figures (360km, 48in) appear to restate the existing ADCOP line's specs rather than the new line's, so not relied on for new-line length here.

'Dhanna-Fujairah crude oil pipeline', 310 miles (~500 km), $3bn ADNOC investment, reported 50% complete as of May 2026, targeting 2027 completion — confirms active construction, not just an announcement.
Confirms sponsor ADNOC, Habshan-Fujairah corridor, ~1.5m bpd added capacity, 2027 target, described as a second/new pipeline (not just debottlenecking).
Independent trade-press corroboration of the same project, capacity doubling and 2027 target.
MEED trade coverage naming it 'West-East pipeline', confirms operational target of 2027, parallel to and roughly doubling the existing Habshan-Fujairah (ADCOP) corridor's bypass capacity.
